description: Curated security allowlist (SPIKE §4.4 lesson 2). Suppresses specific known-public values scoped to (rule_id, file, line) — NOT whole files, so a real future secret in the same file still trips.

allowlist.reason: SPLIT_CLIENT_KEY is a Split.io client-side key, public by design (ships in browser JS). Scoped to this specific value, not the whole file. See phase-3/KNOWN-ISSUES.md and the gitleaks false-fail lesson.
